map.输入隧道断面积、设计控制风速与同时作业人数等参数，计算需风量、最低控制风速并给出: Enter tunnel cross-sectional area, design control velocity and number of workers to compute required airflow, minimum control velocity and fan-selection reference, for construction ventilation design.
map.按风速控制（velocity 模式）：需风量 Q=断面积 A×控制风速 v×36: Velocity control (velocity mode): required airflow Q=area A × control velocity v × 3600 (m³/h), and also Q÷3600 (m³/s); air changes per hour are estimated as v×3600÷100 (based on a 100 m tunnel section). The tool also gives a fan-selection reference: with 2 units in parallel, per-unit flow = Q÷3600÷2 (m³/s).
map.按 CO 稀释（CO 模式）：CO 排放总量=单车排放量 q×小时交通量 N×隧: CO dilution (CO mode): total CO emission = per-vehicle emission q × hourly traffic N × tunnel length L; required airflow Q=q×N×L÷δ (δ is the permissible CO concentration, entered directly as a ppm value); then back out the control velocity v=Q÷3600÷A and air changes n=v×3600÷L.
map.两模式互校与选型：先用风速法得到满足最低风速的风量，再用 CO 法校核稀释有害气: Cross-check the two modes and select: first get the airflow meeting the minimum velocity via the velocity method, then use the CO method to check dilution of harmful gases, taking the larger as the design airflow; fan selection uses the parallel unit count and an airflow margin (typically another 1.1~1.2 safety factor).
map.算例：60 m² 断面、控制风速 2.5 m/s 的风速法: Example: 60 m² section, control velocity 2.5 m/s (velocity method)
map.：风速模式输入 A=60 m²、v=2.5 m/s：需风量 Q=60×2.5×3: : velocity mode with A=60 m², v=2.5 m/s: required airflow Q=60×2.5×3600=540000 m³/h=150.00 m³/s; air changes=2.5×3600÷100=90.00 times/h; fan reference=75.00 m³/s per unit × 2 units. Another set A=80 m², v=2.0 m/s → Q=576000 m³/h=160.00 m³/s, air changes 72.00 times/h, 80.00 m³/s per unit.
map.CO 模式算出的风量为什么比风速法小很多，能直接用吗？: Why is the CO-mode airflow much smaller than the velocity method—can it be used directly?
map.不能直接用。工具的 CO 模式按 Q=q×N×L÷δ 直接代入数值计算：默认 q: No, not directly. The tool's CO mode computes Q=q×N×L÷δ by substituting numbers directly: with defaults q=0.02, N=800 vehicles/h, L=1000 m, δ=100 it outputs Q=160 m³/h (0.04 m³/s), v=0.001 m/s. Here L is entered in metres and δ as a ppm number, without converting to km and volume ratio (100 ppm=1×10⁻⁴) per engineering convention. By the standard form Q=q×N×L(km)÷δ(volume ratio), the same physical conditions give 0.02×800×1.0÷1e-4=160000 m³/h≈44.4 m³/s. So the CO-mode result is only a relative comparison within the same convention; for engineering calculations convert to standard units yourself and take the larger of the velocity method and the code limit.
map.换气次数里的 100 是什么意思？: What does the 100 in the air-changes figure mean?
map.工具按 v×3600÷100 估算每小时换气次数，即默认以 100 m 长的洞段: The tool estimates air changes per hour as v×3600÷100, i.e. it assumes a 100 m tunnel section (velocity times the distance travelled in an hour, divided by the 100 m length). If the actual ventilation zone length differs, convert it yourself as v×3600÷actual length, otherwise the air-change figure is systematically inflated or deflated.
map.→ 打开隧道通风计算工具: → Open the Ventilation Calc (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in your browser and uploads nothing. Results are theoretical estimates under the stated assumptions. Actual work depends on equipment, measurement conditions and local standards; verify against nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult a professional for major decisions.
map.按控制风速法或 CO 稀释法估算需风量，按输入的有效通风长度计算换气次数；可设运: Estimate required airflow by control velocity or CO dilution, and compute air changes from the entered effective ventilation length. Running/standby fan counts and leakage margin are configurable; equal splitting is only a configuration example.
map.控制风速法：需风量 Q=A×v×3600（m³/h）；换气次数 n=Q/(A×L: Control-velocity method: required airflow Q = A×v×3600 (m³/h); air changes n = Q/(A×L) (per hour), where L is the entered effective ventilation length, no longer a fixed 100 m.
map.CO 稀释法：CO 排放总量=q×N×L(km)，L(km)=L(m)/1000: CO dilution method: CO emission = q×N×L(km), with L(km)=L(m)/1000; required airflow Q = q×N×L(km)/δ(volume fraction), δ(volume fraction)=δ(ppm)/10⁶; then back-calculate v=Q/3600/A and n=Q/(A×L).
map.风机配置：设计风量=Q×(1+漏风及系统余量)，按运行台数简单均分得到单台示例风: Fan configuration: design airflow = Q×(1+leakage and system margin), split equally across running fans as an example, with standby count shown; equal splitting is not a selection conclusion.
map.选型边界：必须结合风管漏风、沿程/局部阻力、风机性能曲线、并联效率、海拔/温度修: Selection boundary: consider duct leakage, friction and local resistance, fan performance curves, parallel efficiency, altitude/temperature corrections and standby changeover. Check each operating case; do not conclude from fan count and airflow alone.
map.算例：A=60 m²、v=2.5 m/s、L=1000 m：Q=60×2.5×3: Example: A=60 m², v=2.5 m/s, L=1000 m — Q = 60×2.5×3600 = 540000 m³/h = 150.00 m³/s; n = 540000/(60×1000) = 9.00 air changes/h. With 10% leakage/system margin, 2 running fans and 1 standby: design airflow = 594000 m³/h = 165.00 m³/s, about 82.50 m³/s per running fan as an example; verify against resistance and fan curves. If L becomes 500 m, n = 18.00/h; at the same airflow, air changes vary with effective ventilation length.
map.为什么换气次数不再固定按 100 m 算？: Why is air change no longer fixed at a 100 m length?
map.换气次数是每小时送入风量与空间体积之比，空间体积=断面积×有效通风长度。旧版没有: Air changes are hourly supplied air divided by space volume, and volume = cross-sectional area × effective ventilation length. The old page fixed 100 m without a length input, so tunnels of different lengths showed the same “changes/h”. The tool now requires the effective length and computes Q/(A×L); without a length, no result is shown.
map.把总风量除以运行台数，就能选定风机吗？: Can I select a fan just by dividing total airflow by running fans?
map.不能。均分只是把设计风量摊到运行台数的算术示例，真实选型要考虑风管漏风率、系统阻: No. Equal splitting is only an arithmetic example. Real selection must consider duct leakage, system resistance, fan curves, parallel efficiency, altitude/temperature corrections, airflow during standby changeover, motor power and noise limits. The page exposes fan count, standby and margin, and states that a professional must verify resistance and fan curves.
